#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

struct Mod998 {
    static const long long MOD = 998244353;
    long long value;

    Mod998() : value(0) {}
    Mod998(long long v) : value((v % MOD + MOD) % MOD) {}

    static long long mod() { return MOD; }

    static long long add(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a + b) % MOD;
    }

    static long long subtract(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a - b + MOD) % MOD;
    }

    static long long mult(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a * b) % MOD;
    }

    static long long inv(long long a) {
        // Fermat's little theorem for modular inverse
        return pow_mod(a, MOD - 2);
    }

    static long long pow_mod(long long base, long long exp) {
        long long result = 1;
        long long b = base % MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) result = (result * b) % MOD;
            b = (b * b) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
};

struct NumberTheory {
    struct Modulus {
        virtual long long modulus() const = 0;
        virtual ~Modulus()() {}
    };

    struct Mod998 : public Modulus {
        long long modulus() const override { return 998244353; }
    };
};

class HZSShufflesCards {
public:
    void solve() {
        ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
        int n, m;
        cin >> n >> m;

        long long mod = 998244353;

        // Precompute factorials and inverse factorials for nCr
        vector<long long> fact(n + m + 1, 1);
        vector<long long> inv_fact(n + m + 1, 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n + m; i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        }
        inv_fact[n + m] = Mod998::inv(fact[n + m]);
        for (int i = n + m - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv_fact[i] = (inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod;
        }

        auto nCr = [&](int a, int b) -> long long {
            if (b < 0 || b > a) return 0;
            return (((fact[a] * inv_fact[b]) % mod) * inv_fact[a - b]) % mod;
        };

        // Compute phaseSize
        long long phaseSize = 1;
        long long p = 1;
        for (int i = 0; ; i++) {
            if (p == 0) break;
            long long denom = Mod998::inv(n + m - i);
            p = (p * (n - i)) % mod;
            p = (p * denom) % mod;
            phaseSize = (phaseSize + p) % mod;
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            long long numPhases = ((long long)(m + k) * Mod998::inv(k)) % mod;
            long long term = (nCr(n, k) * numPhases) % mod;
            term = (term * phaseSize) % mod;
            if (k & 1) {
                answer = (answer + term) % mod;
            } else {
                answer = (answer - term + mod) % mod;
            }
        }

        cout << answer << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    HZSShufflesCards solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
